# 1. Reload the daily and weekly primary models + data

```{r load}
# Daily primary (ns df=2 at lag 0-28 d)
daily_model     <- readRDS(paste0(models_folder, "casecrossover_model.RDS"))
daily_df        <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "case_crossover_df.RDS"))
setDT(daily_df)

# Weekly primary (ns df=2 at lag 0-4 wk, CSLT excluded)
weekly_bundle   <- readRDS(paste0(objects_folder, "weekly_primary_ab.RDS"))
weekly_model_A  <- weekly_bundle$model_A
weekly_cc_A     <- weekly_bundle$cc_A
setDT(weekly_cc_A)
```

# 2. Rebuild crossbases for both resolutions (must match what was fit)

```{r rebuild-cb}
DAILY_MAX <- 28
WEEK_MAX  <- 4

# Daily crossbases — primary spec: lin × ns(df=2); bird strata(7, 14, 21)
cb_d_runoff <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(daily_df[, paste0("runoff_Lag", 0:DAILY_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, DAILY_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_d_soil <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(daily_df[, paste0("soil_moisture_Lag", 0:DAILY_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, DAILY_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_d_temp <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(daily_df[, paste0("temperature_Lag", 0:DAILY_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, DAILY_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_d_precip <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(daily_df[, paste0("precipitation_Lag", 0:DAILY_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, DAILY_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_d_wind <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(daily_df[, paste0("wind_speed_Lag", 0:DAILY_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, DAILY_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_d_snow <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(daily_df[, paste0("snow_cover_Lag", 0:DAILY_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, DAILY_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
)
cb_d_bird <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(daily_df[, paste0("anseriformes_Lag", 0:DAILY_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, DAILY_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"),
  arglag = list(fun = "strata", breaks = c(7, 14, 21))
)

# Weekly crossbases — lin × ns(df=2) for ALL six predictors (incl bird)
cb_w_runoff <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(weekly_cc_A[, paste0("runoff_Lag", 0:WEEK_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, WEEK_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_w_soil <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(weekly_cc_A[, paste0("soil_moisture_Lag", 0:WEEK_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, WEEK_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_w_temp <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(weekly_cc_A[, paste0("temperature_Lag", 0:WEEK_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, WEEK_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_w_precip <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(weekly_cc_A[, paste0("precipitation_Lag", 0:WEEK_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, WEEK_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_w_wind <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(weekly_cc_A[, paste0("wind_speed_Lag", 0:WEEK_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, WEEK_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_w_snow <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(weekly_cc_A[, paste0("snow_cover_Lag", 0:WEEK_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, WEEK_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
cb_w_bird <- crossbasis(
  as.matrix(weekly_cc_A[, paste0("anseriformes_Lag", 0:WEEK_MAX), with = FALSE]),
  lag = c(0, WEEK_MAX), argvar = list(fun = "lin"), arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 2)
)
```

# 3. Extract lag-specific + cumulative ORs from each model via manual contrast vectors

```{r extract-lag-response}
extract_lag_response <- function(model, cb_obj, prefix, lag_max) {
  beta <- coef(model); V <- vcov(model)
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", prefix, "v"), names(beta))
  b    <- beta[cols]; Vsub <- V[cols, cols]

  lag_seq   <- 0:lag_max
  lag_basis <- do.call(dlnm::onebasis,
                       c(list(x = lag_seq), attr(cb_obj, "arglag")))

  # Lag-specific (per-lag) — OR if +0.5 SD on that single lag day/week
  lag_specific <- data.table(
    lag = lag_seq,
    OR = NA_real_, OR_lo = NA_real_, OR_hi = NA_real_
  )
  for (i in seq_along(lag_seq)) {
    contrast <- 0.5 * lag_basis[i, ]
    lo <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
    se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast) %*% Vsub %*% contrast))
    lag_specific[i, `:=`(OR = exp(lo),
                         OR_lo = exp(lo - 1.96 * se),
                         OR_hi = exp(lo + 1.96 * se))]
  }

  # Cumulative — OR if +0.5 SD across lags 0..k
  cumulative <- data.table(
    lag = lag_seq,
    OR = NA_real_, OR_lo = NA_real_, OR_hi = NA_real_
  )
  for (i in seq_along(lag_seq)) {
    contrast <- 0.5 * colSums(lag_basis[1:i, , drop = FALSE])
    lo <- as.numeric(contrast %*% b)
    se <- sqrt(as.numeric(t(contrast) %*% Vsub %*% contrast))
    cumulative[i, `:=`(OR = exp(lo),
                       OR_lo = exp(lo - 1.96 * se),
                       OR_hi = exp(lo + 1.96 * se))]
  }
  list(lag_specific = lag_specific, cumulative = cumulative)
}

predictor_map <- list(
  list(name = "Runoff",        daily_cb = cb_d_runoff, daily_prefix = "cb_runoff",
       weekly_cb = cb_w_runoff, weekly_prefix = "cb_runoff_A"),
  list(name = "Soil Moisture", daily_cb = cb_d_soil,   daily_prefix = "cb_soil_moisture",
       weekly_cb = cb_w_soil,   weekly_prefix = "cb_soil_moisture_A"),
  list(name = "Temperature",   daily_cb = cb_d_temp,   daily_prefix = "cb_temperature",
       weekly_cb = cb_w_temp,   weekly_prefix = "cb_temperature_A"),
  list(name = "Precipitation", daily_cb = cb_d_precip, daily_prefix = "cb_precipitation",
       weekly_cb = cb_w_precip, weekly_prefix = "cb_precipitation_A"),
  list(name = "Wind Speed",    daily_cb = cb_d_wind,   daily_prefix = "cb_wind_speed",
       weekly_cb = cb_w_wind,   weekly_prefix = "cb_wind_speed_A"),
  list(name = "Snow Cover",    daily_cb = cb_d_snow,   daily_prefix = "cb_snow_cover",
       weekly_cb = cb_w_snow,   weekly_prefix = "cb_snow_cover_A"),
  list(name = "Anseriformes",  daily_cb = cb_d_bird,   daily_prefix = "cb_anseriformes",
       weekly_cb = cb_w_bird,   weekly_prefix = "cb_anseriformes_A")
)

build_plot_data <- function() {
  rbindlist(lapply(predictor_map, function(p) {
    d_res <- extract_lag_response(daily_model,    p$daily_cb,  p$daily_prefix,  DAILY_MAX)
    w_res <- extract_lag_response(weekly_model_A, p$weekly_cb, p$weekly_prefix, WEEK_MAX)

    # Convert weekly lag to days for unified x-axis
    w_res$lag_specific[, lag_days := lag * 7]
    w_res$cumulative[,   lag_days := lag * 7]
    d_res$lag_specific[, lag_days := lag]
    d_res$cumulative[,   lag_days := lag]

    rbind(
      d_res$lag_specific[, .(Predictor = p$name, Resolution = "Daily",  Type = "Lag-specific",
                              lag_days, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi)],
      w_res$lag_specific[, .(Predictor = p$name, Resolution = "Weekly", Type = "Lag-specific",
                              lag_days, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi)],
      d_res$cumulative[,   .(Predictor = p$name, Resolution = "Daily",  Type = "Cumulative",
                              lag_days, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi)],
      w_res$cumulative[,   .(Predictor = p$name, Resolution = "Weekly", Type = "Cumulative",
                              lag_days, OR, OR_lo, OR_hi)]
    )
  }))
}

plot_data <- build_plot_data()
plot_data[, Predictor := factor(Predictor,
  levels = c("Runoff", "Soil Moisture", "Temperature",
             "Precipitation", "Wind Speed", "Snow Cover", "Anseriformes"))]
```

# 4. Figure 1 — Lag-specific OR side-by-side comparison

```{r fig1-lag-specific, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 8}
fig1_data <- plot_data[Type == "Lag-specific"]

p1 <- ggplot(fig1_data, aes(x = lag_days, y = OR,
                            color = Resolution, fill = Resolution)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = OR_lo, ymax = OR_hi), alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = fig1_data[Resolution == "Weekly"], size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Daily" = "black", "Weekly" = "firebrick")) +
  scale_fill_manual( values = c("Daily" = "black", "Weekly" = "firebrick")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 7, 14, 21, 28),
                     labels = c("0", "7", "14", "21", "28")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "fixed", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    x        = "Lag (days)",
    y        = "Odds Ratio (95% CI), per +0.5 SD on that lag day / week",
    color    = "Resolution",
    fill     = "Resolution",
    title    = "Lag-specific (per-lag) OR — daily vs weekly DLNM",
    subtitle = "Daily: case-crossover lag 0–28 d, ns(df=3); Weekly: lag 0–4 wk, ns(df=2); CSLT excluded"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "top",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(paste0(figures_sensitivity_folder, "figure_daily_vs_weekly_lag_specific.png"),
       p1, width = 14, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)

print(p1)
```

# 5. Figure 2 — Cumulative OR side-by-side comparison

```{r fig2-cumulative, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 8}
fig2_data <- plot_data[Type == "Cumulative"]

p2 <- ggplot(fig2_data, aes(x = lag_days, y = OR,
                            color = Resolution, fill = Resolution)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = OR_lo, ymax = OR_hi), alpha = 0.18, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(data = fig2_data[Resolution == "Weekly"], size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Daily" = "black", "Weekly" = "firebrick")) +
  scale_fill_manual( values = c("Daily" = "black", "Weekly" = "firebrick")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 7, 14, 21, 28),
                     labels = c("0", "7", "14", "21", "28")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Predictor, scales = "fixed", ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    x        = "Cumulative through lag (days)",
    y        = "Cumulative OR (95% CI), per +0.5 SD across lags 0…k",
    color    = "Resolution",
    fill     = "Resolution",
    title    = "Cumulative OR — daily vs weekly DLNM",
    subtitle = "Daily: case-crossover lag 0–28 d, ns(df=3); Weekly: lag 0–4 wk, ns(df=2); CSLT excluded"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "top",
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave(paste0(figures_sensitivity_folder, "figure_daily_vs_weekly_cumulative.png"),
       p2, width = 14, height = 8, units = "in", dpi = 300)

print(p2)
```
